phases.goal: Put the dark gray mouse on the displaystand.
phases.name: place_mouse_on_stand
phases.verify: Mouse rests on the angled stand and gripper is clear.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Mouse is supported by the angled stand before release.

task_language: Grab and put the dark gray palm-sized mouse on the angled black displaystand
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:release(arm=right). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid trusting an occluded mouse placement; verify the mouse moves with the gripper and is supported on the angled displaystand before retreat.
